scope: Independent visual and usability review of About, dashboard, visible primary controls, and directly editable party results. Functional/data regression and remaining five tabs have separate root QA.
verifiedOutcomes: Original author portrait, name, contact, explanatory passages, source links and credits are visible in About.
About has one clearly styled primary start action and secondary source action.
Ask ChatGPT is absent from the inspected UI; a visible light/dark action remains in the top bar.
Six independent primary scenario controls are above the results and visible without opening a disclosure.
Full scenario controls are spread into separately titled panels; only supplementary detailed explanations/settings use disclosures.
Forecast mean mandates and probability of a 61-seat majority have distinct labels and visual hierarchy.
Party names and logos remain readable, with direct native assignment selects and optional drag behavior.
Coalition, unassigned and opposition columns keep continuous separate visual groups, in right/center/left order on desktop.
At 320px party cards switch to complete compact rows, preventing selected bloc labels from truncating.
Dark theme uses lighter bloc metric colors and readable neutral text.

Quick turnout is displayed as 53.2%, rather than long unsupported-looking decimal precision; this is presentation only. Exact-baseline and unchanged-blur behavior is separately verified in control tests.
resolvedFindings: Collapsed V2 settings were difficult to discover: now visible panels and top quick controls.
Primary controls were initially below the full party board: quick controls were moved above results.
About section spacing and mobile author/contact layout were tightened.
Dark bloc colors and unassigned metric colors were improved for readability.
320px native select selected labels were truncated: compact complete rows resolve this.
Quick turnout showed 53.1642655965%: one-decimal presentation resolves this without changing model input.
limitations: This is an expert visual review, not a study with representative naive users.
Element screenshots may contain the persistent shell during automated scroll; full-page screenshots are the authoritative layout evidence.
No poll data, statistical calculations or protected runtime files were edited by the visual reviewer.
